name: jadpo-workers-tools
description: workerd, Cloudflare's own Workers runtime, pinned for the Workers host's tests (docs/compiler-runtime.md §2.6, "The Workers host"), and Wrangler, whose `deploy --dry-run` checks the Wrangler file `jadpo build` writes (chunk 8.2k). Installed here by `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, never globally.
